_help: Keys and books (atlas/CURATION.md "Cards v2"). Per card: keys (who holds the funds or account keys: operator, user_wallet, smart_contract), books (public_transactions, public_dashboard), people (named, with the organization behind it). Fill a value ONLY from a supported claim already on the card: source_url must be that claim's source_url and quote must appear in its quote or statement (check.py and tests/test_cards_v2.py enforce this). keys.basis: operator_says (default; the card shows an attributed claim, "The operator says ...") or onchain_verified (smart_contract only, with contract_url: the contract's page on a public block explorer, ladder level 3). people.names must be one organization from org_names (a company, team or project, optionally followed by a note in brackets); the Atlas lists places, never individual people. Open books are also derived automatically from a supported money-flow claim at ladder level 2 or 3. Every answer not listed here is shown as "not recorded yet". Idea credit: The Caretaker (The Colony).
